problem: The committed revision does not advance until a settings change event. A pending native File.text completion could therefore overwrite newly typed focused text/numeric input and save the incoming film before that input blurred.

reproduction.method: Gate completion after actual native File.text bytes are read; type through native input without blur/change; release the real bytes. No fake film state, storage or WebGL.
beforeFix: Shot-name input1/change0 was overwritten by the imported shot name.
Camera X input1/change0 was overwritten by the imported value 8.
Current authored film and actual localStorage were replaced by the incoming film.
Committed Tab/change control correctly rejected the same pending replacement.
reproduction.newRegressionRed: Two raw-draft cases failed before the repair; the committed-change control passed.

fix: Capture and compare a settings input-intent counter alongside the existing committed revision, import epoch and busy guards before applying an imported project. Input itself does not commit, refresh, save or add history.

verification.independentReview: Clear; exact code and native regressions reviewed without additional edits.
nativeAssertions: Exact Camera X spelling 6.250 retained before blur.
Pending replacement preserves current authored film and durable localStorage.
Later blur commits the valid typed value normally.
Subsequent explicit import and Undo remain usable.
Complete ordinary suite retains real WebGL, independently decoded WebM, controlled XR lifecycle and protected unreadable draft recovery.

localIsolation: A clearly owned ephemeral loopback port and temporary Playwright configuration were used, with system Chromium. No tracked configuration change or unknown server termination. Verification-only node_modules symlink was removed; ordinary pinned npm dependencies were installed from the existing offline cache.
limitations: The timing-only gate establishes a real reachable event-order defect; natural frequency with ungated bounded local reads is not measured.
No physical WebXR/headset verification or new capture-performance claim.
Existing superseded-import status/picker cleanup behavior is unchanged; this repair protects user typing from data replacement.
